newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Digital opens US$10 million Singapore lab.
newsitem.headline: Digital opens US$10 million Singapore lab.

text.p: Digital Equipment Corp officially opened a US$10 million Asia Pacific research laboratory in Singapore on Saturday.

The laboratory "will focus on engineering work that is tightly integrated with the corporate technical strategy," including developing high-end networking solutions in areas incorporating systems and networks via the interent, a Digital statement said.
It said the laboratory team is already working on provision of hardware and software development of the network computer for China Aerospace Corp, among other projects.
The laboratory will employ between 20 and 30 engineers, Digital Asia Pacific President Bobby Choonavala said in a statement.
